newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGE shares to stay on bourse - Messier.
newsitem.headline: SGE shares to stay on bourse - Messier.

text.p: Shares in Societe Generale d'Entreprises (SGE), the building and public works unit of Cie Generale des Eaux (CGE), will remain quoted on the Paris stock market and the company could see a larger part of its capital being quoted, the CGE chairman said.
"Not only will SGE stay on the Bourse but we hope to even increase the size of the float when the market allows," Jean-Marie Messier told weekly Investir, due to appear on Saturday.
CGE currently controls 85 percent of SGE's capital and it wants the public to hold between 35 and 40 percent, he said.
He said that SGE would be significantly profitable from 1997 with a net profit exceeding 300 million francs.
